description: The pie chart presents a breakdown of time (in seconds) across two categories, showing how the total is divided between “Reduction” and “Efficient deployment,” for a total of 2 slices. The larger slice is labeled “Reduction,” colored brown, and is annotated inside the slice as 60.9s (69.92%). The smaller slice is labeled “Efficient deployment,” colored blue, and is annotated as 26.2s (30.08%). Both slices display percentage and time labels within the segments, there is no separate legend, and the blue “Efficient deployment” slice is visually emphasized by being slightly exploded/offset from the rest of the pie.
